related.title: Atom Computing 中途量測：旁觀原子擾動預算
related.titleEn: Atom Computing mid-circuit measurement: spectator-disturbance budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付任務衝突圖、著色證明、甘特圖與新增邊回歸測試。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a conflict graph, coloring proof, Gantt chart and added-edge regression case. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Atom Computing 中途量測：旁觀原子擾動預算』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付有／無讀出配對、累積擾動曲線與中途量測的旁觀驗收。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Atom Computing mid-circuit measurement: spectator-disturbance budget', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver paired readout/no-readout controls, accumulated-disturbance curves and spectator acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學將8個任務排成衝突路徑圖；相鄰不能同時，二著色需2層。總時間=層數×每層時長，忽略跨層切換。 使用每層教學時長2 μs；序列執行8層作基準，任務編號1至8。 以手算或試算表計算名義式8*2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：列7條路徑邊，每條兩端顏色須不同；若新增1–3衝突，原奇偶方案失效，須重新著色。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：若每次讀出對旁觀量子位元造成獨立擾動p，m次後生存代理S=(1−p)^m；不代表完整量子保真度。 使用教學m=20、每次p=0.002；旁觀原子不參與當次讀出。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-0.002)**20，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較m=0、10、20的log(S)斜率；若非線性，檢查相關擾動或時間依賴，而非硬套獨立模型。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Model8 tasks as a conflict path graph; adjacent tasks cannot coincide, so two coloring gives2 layers. Time equals layers times layer duration, excluding switching. Use Teaching layer duration2 μs; sequential8-layer execution is the baseline for tasks1–8. Evaluate nominal expression 8*2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: List all7 path edges and require different colors at both ends; adding conflict1–3 invalidates the odd/even schedule.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: If each readout independently disturbs a spectator with probability p, survival proxy S=(1−p)^m; this is not full quantum fidelity. Use Teaching m=20 and p=0.002 per readout; the spectator is not the measured atom. Evaluate nominal expression (1-0.002)**20 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare log(S) slopes for m=0,10,20; nonlinearity calls for correlated or time-dependent models.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每光子保留率0.95，1000個雙光子介面。 期望擦除介面=N(1−η²)。 代入 1000*(1-0.95**2)，得到 97.5 interfaces。獨立雙光子介面至少一個遺失的機率1−η²；遺失位置可觀測不代表能全部修復。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Model8 tasks as a conflict path graph; adjacent tasks cannot coincide, so two coloring gives2 layers. Time equals layers times layer duration, excluding switching. Use Teaching layer duration2 μs; sequential8-layer execution is the baseline for tasks1–8. Evaluate nominal expression 8*2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: List all7 path edges and require different colors at both ends; adding conflict1–3 invalidates the odd/even schedule.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-photon survival0.95 across1000 two-photon interfaces. Expected erased interfaces=N(1−η²). Substituting 1000*(1-0.95**2) gives 97.5 interfaces. A two-photon interface loses at least one photon with probability1−η²; locating loss does not guarantee correction. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
